title: Wolf in Renaissance Attire
description: An anthropomorphic wolf with detailed fur and amber eyes wears a dark green Renaissance-style doublet, white ruff collar, and a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a large feather. The figure is framed within a large, swirling magenta and olive-green draped fabric or petal-like structure containing faint script and geometric patterns.
prompt: Anthropomorphic wolf with realistic fur and piercing eyes, dressed in ornate dark green Renaissance doublet with white ruffled collar, wearing a dramatic wide-brimmed hat with a large feather, positioned in three-quarter profile looking upward.
